description: This Java class 'ApiExceptionHandler' is a Spring Boot exception handler that manages global exceptions for the application, providing a standardized error response for unhandled exceptions.

classes.name: ApiExceptionHandler
classes.description: A Spring Boot exception handler class that catches all exceptions and returns a standardized error response.

methods.name: handleDefaultException
methods.description: Handles all exceptions by returning a ResponseEntity with an internal server error status and a generic error message.

methods.name: createErrorResponse
methods.description: Static method to create an ErrorResponse builder initialized with the current timestamp and the provided HTTP status.
